item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. Your calendar shows a fixed bedtime and a wind-down routine ahead of it. That's the right structure. Sleep is built in the hours before you lie down, so protect that window. Keep screens and heavy decisions out of it. Let the relaxation practice do its job instead of rushing through it. Keep the wake time steady too, because a consistent rhythm matters more than one perfect night. Your action: tonight, start winding down at your scheduled time and put the phone away.
